description.summary: This spell functions as transform except that it allows the creature to take on the form of a plant creature
description.value: This spell functions as transform except that it allows the creature to take on the form of a plant creature. If you use this spell to cause the target to take on the form of an animal, the spell functions as beast shape IV . If the form is that of an elemental, the spell functions as elemental body III . If the form is that of a humanoid, the spell functions as disguise self . If the form is that of a plant, the spell functions as plant shape II . The subject may choose to resume its normal form as a full-round action; doing so ends the spell.
